title: Fermentation Process
guideExplore: Adjust Temperature and Yeast amount, press Play, and watch sugar turn into CO₂ bubbles and alcohol.
guideBread: Warm dough plus extra yeast makes CO₂ fast — that gas is what makes bread dough rise.
guideBrewing: A cooler, steady temperature ferments slowly, giving a smoother, more controlled flavor.
guideOptimal: Yeast enzymes work fastest near this temperature — watch fermentation speed way up.
conditionsHint: Warmer conditions usually speed up fermentation — until it gets too hot for the yeast.
historyLegend: Yellow = Sugar · Blue = CO₂ · Orange = Alcohol
learnMore: Yeast are living microbes: sugar + yeast → carbon dioxide (bubbles) + alcohol. That reaction is fermentation!
